h:
您好，这是 hunyuan 低 Vram 的半原生舒适 UI 工作流程。

我在我的笔记本电脑 rtx3050 上使用了这个，它的工作时间很长。

如果您没有足够的 vram 来使用原始的 hunyuan 包装器

Wan2.1 很好用！

https://civitai.com/models/1309674/wan-21-low-vram-comfy-ui-workflow-gguf-4gb-vram

笔记

该工作流程包括 Img2vid 工作流程和 text2vid 模型。

这不会对图像进行动画处理，它只是将示例图像放入潜在空间并提供模型样式信息。

如果您的显存较低，那么文本工作流程效果很好，请查看量化版本。

它使用了 GGUF 版本的升级版和步枪X。

如果您的 vram 更少，您可能可以用 Tiledksampler 替换采样器。

安装

请使用 comfyUI 管理器来处理缺少的自定义节点

您需要的型号：

https://huggingface.co/city96/FastHunyuan-gguf/tree/main

我使用“fast-hunyuan-video-t2v-720p-Q5_K_M.gguf”得到了很好的结果

它在 4gb Vram Q8 上运行可能是最好的质量，但需要很长时间..

如果您不想使用快速模型：

https://huggingface.co/city96/HunyuanVideo-gguf/tree/main

Vae 和剪辑/文本编码器

https://huggingface.co/calcuis/hunyuan-gguf/tree/main

hunyuan_video_vae_bf16.safetensors,llava_llama3_fp8_scaled.safetensors

确保更新舒适的 UI 管理器中的所有内容，GGUF 节点可能存在问题，通常可以通过更新修复。

o.en:
Hi this is a semi native comfy UI workflow for hunyuan for Low Vram.

I have use this on my laptops rtx3050 and it works just takes forever.

if you dont have enough vram to use the original hunyuan wrapper

Wan2.1 Works Great!

https://civitai.com/models/1309674/wan-21-low-vram-comfy-ui-workflow-gguf-4gb-vram

NOTES

The workflow includes a Img2vid workflow and a text2vid model.

This does not animate the image it just takes a example image into latent space and gives the model style information.

The Text workflow works great if you have low vram take a look at the quantization versions.

It utilizes the GGUF version of the model a upscaller and rifleX.

if you have even less vram you could probably replace the sampler with the Tiledksampler instead.

INSTALL

Please use comfyUI manager for the missing custom nodes

The models you need:

https://huggingface.co/city96/FastHunyuan-gguf/tree/main

I get pretty good results with "fast-hunyuan-video-t2v-720p-Q5_K_M.gguf"

and it runs on 4gb Vram Q8 is probably the best quality but takes forever..

If you dont want to use the fast models:

https://huggingface.co/city96/HunyuanVideo-gguf/tree/main

Vae and Clip/text encoder

https://huggingface.co/calcuis/hunyuan-gguf/tree/main

hunyuan_video_vae_bf16.safetensors,llava_llama3_fp8_scaled.safetensors

Make sure you update everything in comfy UI manager there can be a problem with the GGUF nodes it is usually fixed with a update.
